note: Source of truth for the Masinloc locations experience. Every place carries two assets from the project's Drive: 'photo' is the raw photograph from Masinloc Website Asset / Regular Images, used as the full-bleed website photography; 'card' is the finished 1:1 pubmat from Masinloc Website Asset / Location, used as the social share image and offered as a download. The description, things-to-do and tags are transcribed verbatim from the pubmat. Do not reassign a photograph to a different place, substitute stock or generated imagery, or add a place that is not listed here. scripts/check-locations.py enforces that destinations.html and the built assets agree with this file.
verification: Each raw photograph was matched against the photograph embedded in the correspondingly labelled pubmat, so the place name comes from the project's own labelling rather than from reading the image.

locations.name: Hamat River
locations.rhyme: Where cool waters flow and green forests gleam, Hamat River feels like nature's quiet dream.
locations.description: A refreshing riverside retreat with flowing clear waters, lush trees, and a calm natural setting.
locations.alt: Hamat River in Sta. Rita, Masinloc

locations.name: San Salvador Island
locations.rhyme: Where blue waters flow and island shores gleam, San Salvador feels like nature's tropical dream.
locations.description: An island destination with quiet shores, open sea views, and a laid-back coastal atmosphere.
locations.alt: San Salvador Island in Masinloc, Zambales

locations.name: Coto Kidz Pool
locations.rhyme: Cool waters waiting beneath the green, Coto Kidz Pool is a refreshing Masinloc scene.
locations.description: A well-loved river escape in Taltal known for cool turquoise waters and a relaxing mountain setting.
locations.alt: Coto Kidz Pool in Taltal, Masinloc

locations.name: San Andres Church
locations.rhyme: Through generations its walls still stay, San Andres welcomes those who come to pray.
locations.description: A historic church and heritage landmark that reflects Masinloc's enduring faith and architectural character.
locations.alt: San Andres Church in Masinloc, Zambales
locations.note: The raw photograph is the front elevation at sunset. The pubmat uses an aerial of the church complex, which is not in Regular Images.

locations.name: Bunga Cave
locations.rhyme: Go beneath the surface, see what time can make, a hidden Masinloc adventure waits inside Bunga Cave.
locations.description: A fascinating cave destination featuring striking rock formations and an adventurous underground atmosphere.
locations.alt: Bunga Cave in Sta. Rita, Masinloc

locations.name: Bacala Sandbar and Guesthouse
locations.rhyme: Where calm blue waters meet the sand, Bacala gives you paradise close at hand.
locations.description: A serene coastal stop where calm waters, a sandbar setting, and a guesthouse stay create an easy beach escape.
locations.alt: Bacala Sandbar and Guesthouse in Masinloc, Zambales

locations.name: Sitio Buri
locations.rhyme: Green hills rising beneath the open sky, Sitio Buri is where the breeze wanders by.
locations.description: A peaceful hillside destination known for open grasslands, fresh air, and sweeping countryside views.

locations.name: Masinloc Baywalk
locations.rhyme: Catch the breeze and watch the whole sky glow, at Masinloc Baywalk, sunset puts on the show.
locations.description: A bright seaside public space perfect for ocean views, easy strolls, and relaxed afternoons.
